text.en: The brand’s Daet listing dates its beginnings to 8 June 2017; this does not date the Naga branch.
DCA expands to D’ Coffee Apartment in the brand’s own account.
The Naga listing places its coffee-and-cake shop in Cereza on Magsaysay Avenue.
